close_body: On a touch screen, the Escape key cap turns into the close mark, since a phone has no Escape key.
body: This is the body of the drawer. It holds any content: text, a form or a list.
outside_off_body: A press outside the drawer does not close it. Use Close or Cancel.
escape_off_body: The Escape key does not close it. A press outside, Close and Cancel still do.
long_body: An entry of the log. The body keeps scrolling while the title above and the buttons below stay where they are, so the user can always reach them.
snap_body: It opens at a peek. Press the handle to raise it to most of the screen, and again to bring it back; drag it down to close.
edit_description: Changes apply from the customer's next order.
sizes_body: Small is 400 px, medium 560 px and large 720 px; full fills the screen less its margins. On a phone every size takes the full width.
details_body: Breathable linen in three colours, cut for a relaxed fit.
stock_body: 42 in the main warehouse, 8 in the city store.
history_body: Price changed last week; restocked on Monday.
review_body: Check the details, then add the product to the catalogue.
order_body: Three items for Sara Haddad, paid by card.
customer_body: A customer since March: twelve orders, all paid on time.
shipping_body: Two zones ship from the main warehouse.
zone_body: Same-day delivery inside the city, free above 200.
payments_body: Cards and Apple Pay are on; cash on delivery is off.
